_comment: A FIXTURE standing in for the semantic classifier on the zero-model path. It is not a model and does not pretend to be one: it is a committed map from terms to extremity groups, replayed through Strands' real structured-output path so a sweep is byte-reproducible offline. A term it does not list is returned at confidence 0.0 and refused by the confidence floor. It has no field for a side; sides are read from the letters by deterministic code. A live classifier replaces it via --model.
